correctness.rationale: Direct substitution gives the exact coboundary derivative with complete cancellation of the Beddington–DeAngelis predation flux and the immature-stage transfer. The standalone checker independently replays the algebra and source-parameter constants exactly.

value.rationale: The motivating paper's central phenomenon is coexistence and multiplicity of periodic branches. The new identity applies simultaneously to every compact recurrent statistical state and all those cycles, is independent of the three predation-response parameters \(a,b,c\), and converts oscillation variance of prey into an exact loss term in the attainable mature-predator mean. At the source parameters it gives the concrete universal ceiling \(\bar z<100/3\) for every non-equilibrium ergodic recurrent state. This is a natural trophic-budget invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputed table entry.
